items.source: v37 00788a1553ff39c912289c60b5acb68c308018a2f85a4343b75d212ed5e3c817, section 0, sentence beginning 'In words: some noise mode that amplifies ... is reachable from the input through Abar and observable at the output through Abar.'
items.precision: This paraphrase is informal. The operative hypothesis is VIS-1 exactly: D0 Abar^{m2} N_j^k P_j Abar^{m1} C != 0 for some bad (j,k) and some m1, m2, i.e. ONE vector N_j^k P_j Abar^{m1} C v of the bad component is observable through Abar. For a bad component of rank >= 2, 'some reachable vector' and 'some observable vector' separately do NOT imply VIS-1. Theorem W, W1-W3 and their proofs use only VIS-1 and are unaffected. Same remark for the v37 section 3 phrase 'reachable and observable through Abar'.
